Session.title: Session
Session.description: Live preference polling game session running on stage host and joined by participants

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the session

currentQuestionIndex.description: 0-based index of the currently active question (0 to 14)

questionStartedAt.description: Server timestamp when the current question was started

durationSeconds.description: Duration allotted for each question in seconds (30)

isPaused.description: Whether the timer is paused by the host

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the session was created

hostUid.description: UID of the session host controller

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description: A player who joined the session via phone

name.description: Participant display name shown on stage lobby

Response.title: Response
Response.description: A participant's 4-option ranking for a specific question

participantName.description: Name of the participant at time of ranking

rankedOptions.description: Array of 4 option IDs ['A','B','C','D'] ordered 1st to 4th preference

secondsToSubmit.description: Seconds taken from question start until submit

/sessions/{code}.description: Main room session document keyed by 6-digit session PIN

/sessions/{code}/responses/{responseId}.description: Private rankings submitted per question per participant
